stem:
This map shows the population distribution of the United States in 1790.

Which statement explains how physical geography affected the population distribution of the United States in 1790?

options.label: A
options.text: The southern states offered fertile farmland, allowing for the development of larger cities.

options.label: B
options.text: The Proclamation Line of 1763 prevented settlers from moving away from the East Coast.

options.label: C
options.text: The Appalachian Mountains served as a barrier that slowed westward expansion.

options.label: D
options.text: The Rocky Mountains posed risks to explorers, leading most people to remain in the East.

visual_elements: Map of the United States showing population density in 1790 with a legend indicating people per square mile ranges: 0-20, 21-75, 76-250, 251-1,000, Over 1,000.
